newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes $4 a tonne higher.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes $4 a tonne higher.

text.p: IPE Oct gas oil closed $4 a tonne higher at $218.50 having managed to hold on to most of the day's gains reaped on the back of fairly bullish U.S. stocks data and strong NYMEX heating oil.
Oct gas oil rose to a high of $219.25 during the morning after American Petroleum Institute data late on Tuesday showed a lower than expected build in distillates for this time of year.

The API said distillate stocks in the key U.S. Northeast region fell 432,000 barrels in the week to 38.5 milion annd were down 17.6 million from a year ago. It also said total crude stocks fell 2.1 million barrels.
"People were trying to push the market up to try to get the market to open higher tomorrow," a gas oil broker said.
NYMEX Oct heating oil was up 1.91 cents at 67.50 a gallon at 1656 GMT.
IPE Brent crude slipped after a flirtation with the highs in the early afternoon following unconfirmed reports of incidents on the Iraq-Iran border, dealers said.

Nov Brent was at 1653 GMT trading up 51 cents at $22.22 a barrel, down from an intra-day high of $22.27 following reports that Iraqi troops had shelled Kurdish refugee camps in Iran and that Iraqi radar tracked a U.S. jet.
Neither report was confirmed and the headlines were worth 10 cents in a market still edgy over the U.S. military build-up in the Gulf and fears of a confrontation with Iraq.
